CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER Heard Sri. Vijaykumar Prakash, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, Sri. B.N. Jagadeesha,
learned Addl.SPP along with Smt. K.P. Yashodha, learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1, Sri.
B.S. Prakash, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
2.
During the pendency of the proceedings, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute among themselves and have filed a joint memo along with an affidavit.

The joint memo reads as follows:
NC: 2025:KHC:10082 "JOINT MEMO OF THE PETITIONERS AND SECOND RESPONDENT 1.

The petitioners herein are arraigned as accused in C. C. No. 27776/2022, pending on the file of the VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Bangalore City, for offences punishable under sections 498 (A), 504 read with 34 of IPC.
2.

6.
